title: Newhalo button
description: A 40px button with 4px corners in five looks: hot orange with black text, thin outline, solid foreground fill, a quiet translucent square and a card-coloured arrow tile. On hover the label rolls up and out while a copy rolls in from below (0.35s), and the colours shift (0.3s, a soft ease-out).
notes: light and quiet are meant for black panels: wrap them in a .dark area
the label is a string so the hover copy can be made; pass an icon for the play-style button
name: newhalo-button

props.name: label
props.description: the visible words; on hover they roll up and a copy rolls in from below

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: orange fill, black text that turns light on hover · outline: thin foreground
border that turns orange on hover · light: foreground fill (white on black panels) ·
quiet: a faint translucent square (language switch, icon buttons) · tile: a card-coloured
square (the arrow buttons in lists) that turns orange on hover

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon in its own darker square at the left (the play button)

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: show only the icon (label becomes the screen-reader name)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link

props.name: disabled
props.description: greys it out and blocks clicks (a form button before the form is filled in)

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the full width of its container
